risk_summary: The excerpt is substantially quantified regarding revenue, margins, costs, commitments, and capital expenditures, but contains extensive repetitive forward-looking disclaimers and broad assumptions. Risk factors include prior-period error corrections, continued operating losses, tariff and input-cost exposure, substantial start-up costs, and reliance on receivables and supplier-financing programs. Management presents a cautiously optimistic 2025 outlook centered on volume growth, productivity gains, and improved cash flows.
